description: Convert a value between units of the same kind: mass, volume or mass concentration. Supported units: kg, g, mg, mcg, ug, µg, ng, L, mL, uL, µL, nL, g/L, mg/mL, mg/L, mcg/mL, ug/mL, µg/mL, mcg/L, ug/L, µg/L, ng/mL. For laboratory calculations only.

from.description: Unit to convert from, for example mg, mL or mg/mL.

to.description: Unit to convert to, of the same kind as from.

name: convert_units
title: Convert units
